cues.en: Now that an account executive can activate a customer's account, let's add the functionality to allow the bank tellers to be able to deposit money to the customer's account.
cues.zh: 現在客戶經理可以啟用客戶帳戶，接著加入讓銀行櫃員替客戶帳戶存款的功能。

cues.en: For this to work, we shall create a transactions table.
cues.zh: 需要建立 transactions 資料表。

cues.en: This table shall house the data related to all transactions in the customer's bank accounts.
cues.zh: 儲存客戶銀行帳戶所有交易的相關資料。

cues.en: Transactions can be deposits, withdrawals, transfers, reversals, etc..
cues.zh: 交易可以是存款、提款、轉帳、沖正等。

cues.en: So you're going to go back to the Project Explorer.
Then I'm going to go to back end up.
Then in the app folder we're going to create a new folder that's going to be transaction like that.
cues.zh: 在 app 資料夾建立 transaction 資料夾。

cues.en: Then within transaction we're going to create a couple of files.
cues.zh: 在 transaction 裡建立幾個檔案。

cues.en: We're going to start with double underscore init double underscore dot pi.
Then create a new file that's going to be enums dot pi.
Then another file that's going to be models dot pi.
And then lastly create another file that's going to be schema dot pi like that.
Then let's start with our enums.
As you can see from enum we're going to import enum.
Then let's create a transaction type enum Baseclass transaction type enum.
Then you can pass a string and enum.
Then we're going to have a deposit transaction.
So deposit that's going to be sent to deposit then withdrawal that's going to be sent to withdrawal then transfer that's going to be sent to transfer.
cues.zh: DEPOSIT 的值為 deposit；WITHDRAWAL 的值為 withdrawal；TRANSFER 的值為 transfer。

cues.en: Then we're going to have a reversal.
That's going to be sent to reversal, then a fee charged.
cues.zh: REVERSAL 的值為 reversal；再來收取費用。

cues.en: That's going to be a fee underscore charged, then loan disbursement.
cues.zh: FEE_CHARGED 的值為 fee_charged；接著貸款撥款。

cues.en: That's going to be loan underscore disbursement then loan repayment.
cues.zh: LOAN_DISBURSEMENT 的值為 loan_disbursement；接著貸款還款。

cues.en: That's going to be loan underscore repayment then interest underscore credited.
cues.zh: LOAN_REPAYMENT 的值為 loan_repayment；再來 INTEREST_CREDITED。

cues.en: That's going to be interest credited.
cues.zh: 值為 interest_credited，也就是利息入帳。

cues.en: Then we're going to create a transaction status enum by saying class transaction status enum.
Then you can pass string and enum.
Then you're going to have a pending status.
cues.zh: 第一種是 pending 狀態。

cues.en: We can set that to pending.
Then completed we're going to set that to completed then failed.
cues.zh: COMPLETED 的值設為 completed，再來 FAILED。

cues.en: We're going to set that to failed.
Then you have reversed.
We're going to set that to reversed then cancelled.
We're going to set that to cancelled like that.
Then lastly we're going to have a transaction category enum.
As you can see, class transaction category enum that's going to be string enum.
cues.zh: 定義 class TransactionCategoryEnum，繼承 str 與 Enum。

cues.en: Then we're going to have the category of credit.
And you can set that to credit.
So credit basically means money coming into the account.
cues.zh: 本例 credit 表示金額進入帳戶。

cues.en: Then debit we can set that to debit.
And debit basically means money going out of the account.
cues.zh: 本例 debit 表示金額從帳戶流出。

cues.en: Then you can save that file.
